timeline.summary: Alkyl Amines resumed gradual production of ammonia-based products following improvements in ammonia supply.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹386.91 Cr (+0.2% YoY), net profit ₹45.37 Cr (-1.4% YoY).
Chintamani Thatte, General Manager (Legal) & Company Secretary, shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 on May 6, 2026, via the company website.
Alkyl Amines hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 6, 2026, guiding for 5-10% volume growth in FY27.
Yogesh Mathradas Kothari, as Promoter, confirmed no encumbrance on Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited shares by promoter group by March 31, 2026.
